name: Middleton Meetup Thursday 2023
information: This competition is being held in series with [Middleton Meetup Tuesday 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiddletonMeetupTuesday2023#general-info). You may only register for one of the two competitions. If you are interested in FMC, we will be holding an FMC mean directly before this competition at [Middleton FMC 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiddletonFMC2023) for free! That competition is not part of this series, so you are able to compete in both this competition as well as the FMC competition. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbHBaIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--775eb9d886ae63e1625875da78d648ae4bc7e286/image.png)
